author: Damián Curti / Caelum Argenteum
tool: Built-in image_gen; transparent_background=true for every call
art_direction: docs/SPRITE_ART_DIRECTION.md; painted pixel-oriented inventory art, subdued nineteenth-century wooden furniture. Existing owned CBICA0 and CLICA0 were inspected as stylistic references, not edited or copied by an external source.
models: Original deterministic construction in generate_dining_sets.py. DATA.json records historical envelope references; GENERATED.json records mesh hashes and material bills. Existing owned basic/luxury chairs and luxury table are reused. No museum/dealer photograph or mesh is packaged.
delivery: Selected generated PNGs are copied byte-for-byte to this directory and src/sprites/caelum/rest_furniture, preserving alpha. No raster postprocessing. Discarded generations remain at their tool-owned paths.

sprites.prompt: Create one transparent-background painted pixel-oriented RPG inventory sprite for Caelum Argenteum, independent dark fantasy inspired by nineteenth-century Argentina. The object is a complete modest wooden dining set: one SMALL ROUND TABLE and EXACTLY TWO simple matching wooden ladderback chairs, on opposite sides. Table about 1.04 m diameter and .74 m high, thin 35 mm round wooden top, square central wooden pedestal with plain crossed feet; chairs .43 m wide with three horizontal back slats, solid wooden seats and four straight legs. Warm subdued honey-brown wood, dark brown grain, soft upper-left highlights, hand-painted low-resolution clustered pixel shading, readable silhouette at 64 pixels, slightly elevated three-quarter view. Show complete objects fully within image with transparent space around them and through all gaps. Compact coherent grouping, no other objects, no people, no food, no plates, no floor, no lettering or numbers, no labels, no border, no photographic or glossy 3D render. Keep all chair legs and the pedestal legible. This is an original sprite, not a scene or product photograph.
sprites.edit_prompt: Edit this RPG inventory sprite to remove the entire dark brown/black glowing background and all floor shadows. Preserve the round wooden table and exactly two chairs, their geometry and painted pixel-style shading unchanged. Every background pixel, including the gaps between the legs, pedestal and chair backs, must be fully transparent alpha. No new backdrop, no glow, no opaque checkerboard, no floor. Return only the three furniture objects cut out cleanly on genuine transparency.

sprites.prompt: One transparent-background inventory sprite, original hand-painted pixel-oriented nineteenth-century Argentine dark-fantasy RPG art. Genuine alpha transparency around all objects and through all leg/backrest gaps.

It must have TWELVE: FIVE chairs along the far long side, FIVE along the near long side, ONE at each short end.
